## In plain words

What a plan costs$20 a month per company on Standard, or $200 on Pro. Billed monthly, cancel any time. No fee per person.

What credits arePrepaid dollars in your company's balance. Every month the plan adds its price back as credits: $20 on Standard, $200 on Pro.

How agents use themYour agents spend credits as they work: thinking, searching the web, running their computer. An agent that is waiting spends nothing.

If you need moreTop up any time. Unused credits roll over and never expire. The exact rates for every kind of work are below.

Free trial

$0for 7 days

Try Standard free for 7 days. Add a card to start; cancel any time before the trial ends.

- $10 of credit to try it on
- Everything Standard does, from day one
- Cancel before day 7 and you are not charged
- Then $20/mo on Standard

[Start free trial](https://app.usenaive.ai/)

$20/mo

Everything the platform does, with $20 of credit every month.

- $20 of credit included each month
- Pay as you go for more credit — top up the prepaid balance any time
- No per-seat fee — one plan covers the whole organization
- MCP, the SDK and the CLI are not metered

[Get started](https://app.usenaive.ai/)

For teams running many agents at once, with $200 of credit every month. Past that, the same rates.

## What a bill is made of

Four components, each on your spend breakdown under its own name. Two are quoted before they run and two are metered from what they used.

- Per token, five tiers


### Model inference


Input, cached reads, cache writes, output and reasoning are metered as five disjoint tiers, at the tariff for the completion window the request asked for.

- Per second, while running


### Computer


vCPU and memory on what the machine was given. Nothing to create one, nothing while it sleeps, and the boot disk is inside the allowance, so a computer waiting between turns meters nothing at all.

- Per call


### Web tools


Priced from what the provider charged, so a web call is booked after it runs. A fetch your domain policy refuses is stopped before the request and costs nothing.

- What the job cost


### Media generation


Billed once per finished job, at its real cost, a render cannot be quoted before it runs, so it is admitted against the headroom under the agent's per-task cap instead. A job that fails is not billed.


## The rates

A session’s computer is 1 vCPU / 1 GiB, so a full hour of it running is $0.0504 + $0.0162 =$0.0666, and an agent waiting between turns is metered for nothing.

- Computer · vCPU$0.0504/hr
$0.000014 per second, while running
- Computer · memory$0.0162/GiB-hr
$0.0000045 per GiB-second
- Computer · paused$0
no vCPU, no memory, no storage
- Computer · created$0
there is no creation fee
- web\_search$0.00166/call
one query, up to 10 results
- web\_fetch$0.00083/call
one page read as text
- Mobile sandbox · Android$0.050/device-min
create to end, whole minutes, residential network included
- Mobile sandbox · iPhone$0.080/device-min
create to end, whole minutes, residential network included
- data\_runListed
the tool's own price, per run; search and describe are free
- MCP, SDK and CLI$0
the interfaces are not metered
- Seats$0
no per-seat fee, however many people use the organization

Every rate is the price you pay: the number the ledger books and your spend breakdown reports.

[Full price list](https://usenaive.ai/docs/platform/pricing)

## The completion windowis the biggest lever.

The same model at a different window is a different price, and you choose it per request. Pay the interactive tariff only when a person is waiting. Overnight work runs on `loose`for materially less.

- `immediate`Answers nowHighest tariff
- `priority`Answers soonLower tariff
- `loose`Answers eventuallyLowest tariff

## Questions

How does the free trial work?Standard starts with 7 days free and $10 of credit to try it on (not on a prepaid card, a card the bank cannot verify, or one that already had a trial). You add a card when you start so nothing interrupts your agents when the trial ends; cancel any time before day 7 and you are not charged. After that it is $20 a month with the full $20 of credit. One trial per organization and per person, on Standard only.

What happens when the included credit runs out?Your agents keep working on the prepaid balance. Top it up any time and usage is billed at the same published rates, per call and per second, with nothing charged for a computer that is sitting still.

Can I switch between Standard and Pro?Yes. Both plans run the same platform at the same rates; the only difference is the credit each paid month includes — $20 on Standard, $200 on Pro. Upgrade to Pro from the Credits page (Settings → Credits) and it takes effect at once; move back to Standard and it takes effect at the end of the month you have already paid for.

What happens to credit I don't use?It rolls over. Each paid month adds the plan's included credit to your organization's prepaid balance, alongside anything you top up, and it never expires. Your spend breakdown shows exactly what has been used.

## Measured, not modelled.

Every figure is corrected against vendor invoice brackets; list-price rate cards overstate real cost by up to 4.2×. The method, and the cost per completed task, are on the bench.

[See the benchmarks](https://usenaive.ai/benchmark) [Talk to us](https://cal.com/seandorjeceo/15min)
